summary: Preserve eager class-evaluation timing and textual interleaving of JavaScript static fields and static blocks.

target.notes: Generate an explicit class-initialization routine and invoke it exactly at the JavaScript class evaluation point; execute static elements in source order. Do not rely on CLR lazy static initialization timing.

semantics.order: textual order across static fields and blocks
semantics.superclass_static_initialization: superclass class evaluation has already occurred before subclass definition when referenced normally

caveats: CLR static initialization may be lazy and has different base/derived ordering; direct C# static field initializers are not a general substitute.

tests.name: interleaved order
tests.input: class C { static a=console.log('a'); static { console.log('b'); } static c=console.log('c'); }
tests.expected_csharp: JsClass.Initialize(/* C */, () => { /* a */ /* block b */ /* c */ });
tests.expected_behavior: prints a then b then c while evaluating the class declaration

tests.name: edge: class definition side effect is eager
tests.input: console.log('before'); class C { static x=console.log('init'); } console.log('after');
